output.question: What is Stripe's valuation?
output.answer: The latest official figure for Stripe's valuation is $159 billion (about €135 billion). Stripe set that number in an employee tender offer it announced on February 24, 2026, funded mostly by investors including Thrive Capital, Coatue and a16z, with Stripe also using its own money to buy back shares. The previous mark was $106.7 billion in 2025. A statistics page last updated in October/November 2026 still lists $159B as Stripe's latest announced tender valuation, and I found no newer official round. Stripe is private, so this is a tender price rather than a market cap. Co-founder John Collison said there were no imminent plans to go public.
output.as_of: 2026-02-24 (latest official valuation; no newer one found as of 2026-11-11)

key_facts.fact: Stripe announced a tender offer for current and former employees that values the company at $159 billion (€135 billion). Most of the money comes from investors such as Thrive Capital, Coatue and a16z, and Stripe is also buying back shares.
The $159B valuation is up from the $106.7B Stripe secured the year before, and Collison said there were no imminent plans to go public.

A Stripe statistics page from Chargeflow said that as of October 13, 2026, the February 2026 $159B tender was still the latest tender valuation Stripe had announced, and that this is not a public market capitalization.

passages.quote: un'offerta pubblica di acquisto che valuta l'azienda 159 miliardi di USD (135 miliardi di euro)
Stripe reached a $159 billion valuation, according to co-founder and president John Collison

the latest tender valuation Stripe has announced

caveats: $159B is a private tender-offer valuation, not a public market cap. Stripe has not filed for an IPO.

Search results mention higher secondary-market prices: about $172–177B in July/August 2026 (Hiive/Caplight) and about $184.4B as of October 1, 2026 (Forge data via Benzinga). I did not open or confirm those pages, and Stripe has not endorsed any of these figures.
Stripe's newsroom page came back in Italian. The number ($159B / €135B) and the date match the English coverage.
A newer tender or funding round between mid-October and November 11, 2026 could have been missed. None turned up in the searches.
